name: hazel_weir_in_situ_compounding_graph
description: Optimized Procedural Graph featuring synchronized 18-20 plot land-labor expansion, in-situ harvest-and-water Strawberry compounding through Day 24-25, duration-gated Town Shop arbitrage, and high-margin market pricing defense.

nodes.name: State & Balance Audit
nodes.description: Computes net available cash, shed fill percentage, wage liability, active shop contract demand, and oracle price drop signals across market commodities.

nodes.name: Midnight Wage Reserve Defense
nodes.description: Protects payroll for all active hired hands. Enforces dynamic cash reserve locks and triggers pre-midnight surplus liquidation to prevent the 0-hand bankruptcy cascade, maintaining livestock feed reserves strictly at n_animals * 3 to eliminate phantom wheat hoarding.

nodes.name: Town Shop Demand Arbitrage
nodes.description: Fulfills active town shop contracts for 2.0x-3.5x premiums. Enforces crop-growth duration feasibility gating on seed purchases (remaining steps >= growth + buffer, day <= 25), prohibiting slow single-harvest crops (unfertilized Pumpkins/Tomatoes) unless premium exceeds 3.0x base price, while routing all uncontracted surplus to open-market sales.

nodes.name: Capital Velocity & Liquidation
nodes.description: Maintains capital velocity through frequent batch sales (8-10 units) at favorable prices (>= 0.88x base), unlocking fluid cash for reinvestment while eliminating ruinous 0.60x dumps by enforcing a hard 0.82x liquidation price floor under emergency shed pressure (occupancy >= 75%).

nodes.name: Oracle Opponent Front-Run
nodes.description: Reads 96-step TTM forecast with desensitized risk threshold (>= 0.55) to preemptively liquidate sensitive commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) at favorable prices (>= 0.82x base) before opponent market gluts collapse prices.

nodes.name: Capital Reinvestment & Yield Scaling
nodes.description: Reinvests surplus cash into workforce scaling (up to 10 hands), synchronous land expansion (16 plots by Day 10, 18-20 plots by Day 15 gated by 2.0x payroll liquidity lock through Day 16), and hyper-fertilized Strawberry compounding through Day 24-25 without premature low-margin crop pivots.

nodes.name: Routine Farm & Workforce Execution
nodes.description: Executes routine field operations with atomic in-situ Harvest-then-Water micro-routing on mature perennial plots to eradicate growth-pausing dry intervals. Restricts shed drop-off transit to inventory saturation or step 714 final conversion to maximize worker field efficiency.

attributes.guidance: Cancel non-essential purchases; schedule worker harvest drop-offs before hour 21; enforce emergency liquidation of non-feed, non-contract inventory at hour >= 20 to guarantee payroll.
attributes.pitfalls: Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3); never liquidate crops committed to active town shop delivery.

attributes.condition: has_unlocked_shops and (shop_deliverable_inventory > 0 or (net_available_cash >= 180.0 and active_shop_demand > 0 and day <= 25)) and day <= 30
attributes.guidance: Allocate market slots to deliver matching inventory to town shops for 2.0x-3.5x premiums through step 710. Strictly gate seed procurement by growth duration feasibility: buy shop seeds only if remaining contract steps >= crop growth time + safety buffer and current day <= 25. Prohibit planting slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) unless contract premium exceeds 3.0x base price; fulfill contracts primarily from existing Strawberry inventory or rapid 3-day Carrots.
attributes.pitfalls: Never buy slow-crop seeds (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) after Day 20 or when contract expiry is less than crop growth steps. Never hoard inventory speculatively for unrevealed contracts; instantly release uncontracted surplus to open-market liquidation. Do not buy shop seeds if net cash falls below 1.25x midnight payroll.

attributes.guidance: Execute batch sales (8-10 units) of unreserved, non-shop surplus holdings when market price >= 0.88 * base_price, or when shed occupancy hits 30% to maintain capital velocity. If shed occupancy reaches 75%, relax price floor to an absolute minimum of 0.82 * base_price to prevent shed saturation; never panic dump below 0.82 * base_price.
attributes.pitfalls: Never liquidate exact item quotas reserved for active town shop contracts. Never dump below 0.82 * base_price under any circumstances. Never sell Wheat below dynamic livestock feed reserve (n_animals * 3).

attributes.guidance: Preempt lowest-margin open orders; execute rapid batch liquidations of vulnerable commodities (Wool, Milk, Strawberry) when high glut risk (>= 0.55) is detected while current market price remains favorable (>= 0.82 * base_price) before opponent dumping collapses market prices.
attributes.pitfalls: Do not fire-sale into weak signals (risk < 0.55); never dump below 0.82 * base_price; do not front-run commodities committed to active town shop contracts.

attributes.condition: net_available_cash >= midnight_payroll_due * 1.5 + 100.0 and (hired_hands < 10 or uncultivated_plots > 0 or has_fertilizer_deficit) and day <= 26
attributes.guidance: Scale workforce aggressively to 10 hands (11 total hands). Synchronously expand contiguous land to 16 plots by Day 10 (when hands >= 6) and 18-20 plots by Day 15 (when hands >= 9), matching workforce to ~1.8 plots per hand. Enforce strict expansion liquidity lock: purchase new plots only when day <= 16 and net available cash exceeds 2.0x midnight payroll plus plot and input costs; cease all land expansion after Day 16. Maintain hyper-fertilized Strawberries as the exclusive compounding engine across all plots through Day 24-25. Never dig up or overwrite an active perennial Strawberry plot. Restrict fast-crop Carrots strictly to Day 25+ on vacant or newly cleared plots where Strawberries cannot complete two full harvest cycles before step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never expand land beyond 20 plots or after Day 16. Never execute plot expansion without 2.0x payroll reserve plus input costs. Never prematurely pivot to Carrots before Day 25 or overwrite mature Strawberry plots. Do not plant slow single-harvest crops (Pumpkins, Tomatoes) unless explicitly demanded by active high-margin shop contracts. Ensure continuous fertilizer replenishment for all Strawberry plots.

attributes.guidance: Enforce atomic in-situ servicing: any worker positioned on a mature perennial plot must Harvest and immediately Water that plot before moving to adjacent tiles, completely eliminating regrowth-halting dry intervals. Restrict shed drop-off transit strictly to when carried inventory reaches full capacity or at step 714 for final game conversion. Routine priority: 1) In-situ Harvest-then-Water on mature perennials, 2) Water remaining dry plots, 3) Full-inventory shed drop-off, 4) Feed livestock, 5) Plant seeds, 6) Weed/Till. Deposit all carried inventory by step 716.
attributes.pitfalls: Never leave a harvested perennial plot unwatered before moving, as dry intervals freeze regrowth cycles. Do not trigger shed transit with partial inventory loads prior to step 714. Ensure workers never idle while unharvested crops or dry plots remain.
